note: Two reusable rules emerged from the Dockerfile work and its review: keep deployment docs in sync with the runtime image, and bundle all filesystem startup dependencies into the runtime image.

candidates.text: Container deployment guides must reference commands and paths that exist in the runtime image.
candidates.rationale: The review found that deploy/README.md instructed Coolify to run go-run-based scripts inside the new single-container image, which has no Go or scripts directory. Updating the docs (and the helper script fallback) prevents runtime failures in containerized deployments.

candidates.text: A runtime image must include every filesystem dependency the application needs at startup, such as migration directories, templates, and static config files.
candidates.rationale: The first Docker build succeeded but the container crashed on startup because db/migrations was missing from the runtime image. Copying it into the image fixed startup, illustrating that compile-time dependencies alone are not enough.
